obligation: G008 - measured CPU/GPU physical consequence: bytes/token and dispatch
method: active bytes/token = all non-expert stored bytes + one embedding ROW + (topk/n_experts) x expert stored bytes. topk=6, n_routed_experts=64, 26 MoE layers of 27. Experts kept in PACKED quantized form (nn.quantize, 78/78 QuantizedSwitchLinear asserted), not dequantized to dense.
FINDING_bandwidth_bound_only_above_q4: bf16 achieves 452 GB/s, about 57% of peak - genuinely bandwidth-bound. Every quantized config achieves 144-186 GB/s, 18-23% of peak. Below q4 the decode is NOT bandwidth-bound, which is the MECHANISM behind the saturation recorded in O003_PARETO_MEASURED.json. The ~128 tok/s ceiling is a per-token fixed cost - dispatch, routing, expert gather, dequantisation - not traffic. Removing bytes below q4 cannot buy decode speed because bytes stopped being the constraint.
CORRECTION_to_earlier_TPS_numbers: Warm 6-rep medians: bf16 87.67 (min 87.46 max 87.94, spread 0.5%), q4-g64 127.48 (119.10-128.26, 7.7%), q2-g64 128.97 (126.01-134.48, 6.7%). The earlier absolute figures (bf16 69.97 and 73.63, q4 98.24, q2-g32 100.01) were taken with two repeats and one warmup and are systematically LOW. The RANKING held but the magnitudes were wrong: the real bf16->q4 gain is +45.4%, not +35.8%, and bf16's range does not overlap q4's (87.94 max vs 119.10 min).
CORRECTION_q4_to_q2_is_not_resolvable: q4-g64 127.48 (119.10-128.26) and q2-g64 128.97 (126.01-134.48) OVERLAP heavily. The q4->q2 difference is not measurable at this precision. Saturation below q4 is confirmed and now carries a real error bar instead of a bare +1.8% point estimate.
MY_DRIFT_DIAGNOSTIC_WAS_SELF_DEFEATING: variance.py sorted the samples before computing monotone_drift_check, so that field just repeats spread_pct and says nothing about ordering. Drift cannot be assessed from this data. The ordered series must be retained to separate DVFS ramp from jitter.
DISPATCH_COUNT_NOT_MEASURED: mx.metal exposes only start_capture/stop_capture, which emit a .gputrace requiring Xcode to read. There is no dispatch counter in the Python API. Not estimated, not inferred - simply unmeasured.
CAVEATS: Peak bandwidth 800 GB/s is the M3 Ultra spec figure, not measured on this machine; utilization percentages inherit that assumption.
active bytes/token assumes every routed token hits exactly topk distinct experts and ignores KV/state growth, so it is a lower bound on real traffic.
q3-g64 TPS is a single warm run, not a 6-rep median like the others.
